card.name: Start of the word Decrease
card.fires_on: The partial word "Decre" just before "ase" or "ases", where a decrease or reduction is about to be named. It appears in headings, table cells and dose-adjustment instructions.

modes.label: Dose-adjustment tables
modes.description: "Decre" opens an instruction to lower a dose after a lab value or heart rate threshold.
modes.example: .5 mg twice daily 50 to 60 bpm Maintain dose < 50 bpm or signs and symptoms of bradycardia<< Decre>>ase dose by 2.5 mg

modes.label: Headings and effect labels
modes.description: "Decre" starts a heading or short phrase naming a drop in a lab value or drug level.

card.writes: It pushes up odd word starts and suppresses increase and reduce words, so it seems to block other synonyms after "Decre".
card.plain: It fires when the text is partway through writing the word decrease, usually in dose tables and warnings about falling levels.
